subject: Confidential pilot stipend & onboarding plan for VPC POC
messages:
From: Ana Silva <ana@medsecure.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: confidential VPC pilot stipend and onboarding checklist

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week — team was impressed by the runtime profiles for long-context retrieval. We want to run a small VPC-triggered POC that must stay within our private cloud for compliance reasons (HIPAA-ish controls). Before we start, procurement asked if Redwood can provide a short-term pilot stipend (compute credits) plus an onboarding checklist tailored to private/VPC deployments so our security team can validate requirements.

Key asks from our side:
- A one-time pilot stipend to cover ~3 weeks of evaluation (estimate: 200k token-equivalents)
- A security evidence checklist (SOC2 items, network segmentation diagram, KMS/HSM approach)
- A proposed mutual action plan and timeline we can share with our CISO

I can loop in our procurement lead (procure@medsecure.ai) and Mark (finance) if needed. Happy to sign an MoU or PIA.

Regards,
Ana
Ana Silva
Head of ML Infrastructure
MedSecure.ai
[Attachment: SOC2-excerpts.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ana Silva <ana@medsecure.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: confidential VPC pilot stipend and onboarding checklist

Ana — thanks for the clear asks and for bringing the team along. We can support a private/VPC POC and provide a pilot stipend under a short MoU and evidence review. Quick notes and proposed next steps:

1) Pilot stipend: we can approve a one-time stipend equivalent to 250k token credits for a 30-day confidential pilot. This is a discretionary approval for security-gated trials; final release contingent on receipt of the evidence checklist items below.

2) Evidence/checklist: please share the SOC2 excerpts (received) plus a high-level network diagram and primary KMS vendor. Our security review will focus on data-in-transit controls, KV-cache isolation, and logging/audit access.

3) Mutual action plan (proposed):
   - Day 0–2: Exchange MoU & access window; confirm IP allowlist and service account provisioning
   - Day 3–10: Security review + smoke test in isolated subnet (we provide a runbook)
   - Day 11–30: Full feature validation; telemetry & cost baseline; optional canary traffic from non-prod
4) Doc/links: attaching a short MoU draft & our onboarding runbook for private deployments.

If that sounds OK I can route the stipend request through finance and security for approval — will need sign-off from Karthik (security sponsor) and Jonas (finance) to release credits. If procurement prefers, we can send a DocuSign MoU.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pilot-mou-draft.docx]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Ana Silva <ana@medsecure.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: confidential VPC pilot stipend and onboarding checklist

Marissa/Ana — quick follow-up from security. We appreciate the SOC2 excerpt; before we can clear the stipend we need the following minimal items:
- Network diagram showing egress controls and whether any traffic will traverse public internet
- Confirmation of customer-managed KMS (or details on a KMS escrow approach if using our KMS)
- List of test datasets (no PHI in transferred datasets during evaluation)

Operationally, we can run the security review in 48–72 hours if Ana provides the network drawing and confirms the KMS approach. If you need a privacy addendum, we have a standard PIA template.

Jonas — if security signs off within 72 hours I recommend approving the 250k stipend and a 30-day window. Please confirm and I will mark this as security-cleared.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Security & Privacy
Redwood Inference

From: Ana Silva <ana@medsecure.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@medsecure.ai>, Mark Daniels <mark.daniels@medsecure.ai>
Date: 2026-09-19T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: confidential VPC pilot stipend and onboarding checklist

Thanks Marissa and Karthik — attaching the network diagram and a short procurement note. We can confirm:
- All pilot traffic will be contained within our VPC and routed through a private peering connection (no public egress).
- KMS is customer-managed (HashiCorp Vault) and keys will not be shared.
- Test datasets are synthetic; no PHI exported.

Procurement asked if the pilot window can be extended to 45 days (instead of 30) to accommodate a regulatory review cycle. They also asked for a billing contact and a simple signed MoU.

Attachments: network-diagram-v1.png; procurement-note.pdf

—Ana
[Attachment: vpc-network-drawings.png]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ana Silva <ana@medsecure.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: confidential VPC pilot stipend and onboarding checklist

Perfect — thanks for the fast turnaround, Ana. Summary and next steps:

- Stipend approved: one-time 250k token-equivalent credits, valid for 45 days starting on the first successful private-connect smoke test.
- Conditioning: release upon (a) signed MoU (DocuSign link below) and (b) security clearance (Karthik) after review of the attached diagram and KMS confirmation.
- Billing contact for invoices: Mark Daniels <mark.daniels@medsecure.ai>. Finance will set this as the billing recipient for any overage invoices post-pilot.

Action items:
1) Ana: please sign the MoU via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/en/documents/abcdef123456 (I attached a clean copy).
2) Karthik: security to confirm clearance by EOD tomorrow if possible.
3) Jonas/Finance: hold release of credits until DocuSign completed and clearance logged.

I'll queue this in our billing/credits flow and will confirm the actual credit token id once posted (you'll get a notice from billing@redwoodinference.com). Excited to get this running.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: onboarding-runbook.pdf]
